subject: Does the app need cross-origin isolation to open its database?
method: The real app, driven in Playwright. SharedArrayBuffer is deleted before any app script runs, which is the condition Android Chrome and iOS Safari impose on a page that is not cross-origin isolated. The outcome is what the user sees: the course-creation screen, or the archive-unavailable message.

conclusion: The database opens, takes a write and keeps it across a reload without SharedArrayBuffer, so the app does not need cross-origin isolation and any static host will do.
